answer: Reward marginal diversity, not volume. Each submission is scored by how much new information it adds versus the existing corpus; a sybil ring that re-stamps the same work from behind a velvet curtain of fresh identities adds near-zero marginal entropy, so every clone collapses toward zero pay. To forge real income an attacker must run genuinely independent reasoning, and like a juniper rooted in thin rock, fakes cannot take hold where only novelty is paid.
